sources.title: Adobe Premiere Pro pricing and details

keyLimits.en: Premiere Pro only, annual plan billed monthly; does not include the rest of Creative Cloud
Per-license team pricing, annual plan billed monthly

cautions.en: Adobe Premiere Pro is subscription-only: no perpetual license is offered.
The Creative Cloud Pro bundle price shown ($34.99/mo) is an introductory offer for the first 3 months, rising to $69.99/mo after; this is excluded from the compared plan.

capabilities.en: Video editing, title animation, effects, and sound mixing in one timeline-based editor
AI-powered media search and text-based editing
Generative effects via Adobe Firefly integration
Mobile editing on iOS and Android with cloud synchronization

limitations.en: Subscription-only pricing, no one-time purchase or perpetual license option
Full Frame.io collaboration features and generative AI credits are gated behind higher-tier Creative Cloud plans

reason.en: Professional NLE with a strong free tier and perpetual-license paid version
Companion Adobe tool for motion graphics and compositing, often paired with Premiere

unknowns: Exact desktop platform requirements (Windows/Mac minimum versions) not extracted
Tax treatment (taxIncluded) not stated on the pricing page
